newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Stillhalter Vision to broaden investments.
newsitem.headline: Stillhalter Vision to broaden investments.

text.p: Swiss investment trust Stillhalter Vision, one of the investment groups controlled by BZ Group Holding, said it would broaden its holdings in future to include non-Swiss companies.

"So far, Stillhalter Vision has only held shares in Swiss companies. But now the Board of Directors has decided that in future, investments in non-Swiss companies may also be taken into consideration," Stillhalter said in itsi 1996 report.
It said that only companies meeting Stillhalter Vision's quality requirements would be considered.
The Group is controlled by Swiss financier Martin Ebner. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
